# kardashev

> Free, open-source Python and JavaScript/TypeScript client for US ISO/RTO energy data. Direct access to CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP, and PJM. No API key required for 6 of 7 ISOs. A free alternative to gridstatus, with JavaScript/TypeScript support gridstatus does not have.

kardashev provides two ways to get US grid data: direct scrapers that hit each ISO's own public feed (no API key, no rate limits, no third-party dependency), and a free hosted API (data.kardashevlabs.org) for normalized cross-ISO data — locational marginal prices (LMP), system load, fuel mix, carbon intensity, curtailment, and interconnection queues.

Install:
- Python: `pip install kardashev`
- JavaScript/TypeScript: `npm install kardashev`

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://docs.kardashevlabs.org/quickstart): install and first API calls in both languages
- [Installation](https://docs.kardashevlabs.org/installation): setup for pip and npm
- [Supported ISOs](https://docs.kardashevlabs.org/supported-isos): CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP, PJM coverage detail
- [API Reference](https://docs.kardashevlabs.org/api-reference): full method reference for both clients
- [Examples](https://docs.kardashevlabs.org/examples): LMP, fuel mix, carbon intensity, curtailment, interconnection queue code samples
- [kardashev vs gridstatus](https://docs.kardashevlabs.org/comparison): feature and dependency comparison
- [Data Sources](https://docs.kardashevlabs.org/data-sources): upstream feeds and refresh cadence per ISO
- [Changelog](https://docs.kardashevlabs.org/changelog)
- [Roadmap](https://docs.kardashevlabs.org/roadmap)
